name: Surface Recovery via Alpha Thresholding and Poisson Reconstruction
definition: A method to generate high-quality meshes post-training by identifying surface points from high-gradient regions and performing Poisson surface reconstruction.
summary: Surface Recovery via Alpha Thresholding and Poisson Reconstruction generates watertight meshes from neural radiance fields by identifying surface points through alpha thresholding and reconstructing geometry via Poisson reconstruction.
